tw_sister.description: A bright, cheerful young woman in her early twenties from Taiwan who hosts a children's TV show, speaking Taiwan Mandarin (台灣國語) with a natural Taiwanese accent; lively, playful and very clear.

tw_teacher.description: A gentle, warm female kindergarten teacher in her late twenties from Taipei, speaking Taiwan Mandarin (台灣國語) with a natural Taiwanese accent; soft, smiling and patient, with clear, careful articulation for young children.
